mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM shop WHERE id=#{shopId} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT q.id,q.region,q.shop_id,q.user_id,q.content,q.answer_count,q.status,q.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, (SELECT a.content FROM shop_answer a WHERE a.question_id=q.id AND a.status=1 AND a.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_answer FROM shop_question q LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=q.user_id WHERE q.shop_id=#{shopId} AND q.region=#{region} AND q.status=1 AND q.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_question WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND region=#{region} AND status=1 AND is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT q.id,q.region,q.shop_id,q.user_id,q.content,q.answer_count,q.status,q.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM shop_question q LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=q.user_id WHERE q.id=#{id} AND q.shop_id=#{shopId} AND q.region=#{region} AND q.status=1 AND q.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT q.id,q.region,q.shop_id,q.user_id,q.content,q.answer_count,q.status,q.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM shop_question q LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=q.user_id WHERE q.id=#{id} AND q.shop_id=#{shopId} AND q.region=#{region} AND q.user_id=#{userId} AND q.is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT id,region,shop_id,user_id,content,answer_count,status,created_at FROM shop_question WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_question SET answer_count=answer_count+1 WHERE id=#{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.region,a.question_id,a.user_id,a.content,a.status,a.created_at,u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM shop_answer a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE a.question_id=#{questionId} AND a.status=1 AND a.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY a.id
